title: Backcasting Multi-Turn Sabotage Detection: Does Persuasion-Probe Signal Rise Before an Agent Defects?

original_idea.body: On SHADE-Arena public transcripts compute a per-turn linear-probe or entropy signal and test whether it trends upward before a sabotage step (lead-time analysis).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Early-warning lead-time for sabotage enables intervention before irreversible harm.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probes/entropy on public transcripts with inherited probe methodology; novice plus mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused lead-time analysis on existing transcripts; probe training adds one step.

low_compute.reasoning: Activation extraction plus linear probe on open model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Linear probes for deception exist; the pre-defection lead-time framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe-based deception detection exists; lead-time-before-defection angle may be open.
